sentence_cue_checks.text: Choose how you want to install spaCR.
cues: Choose how you want to install spaCR.

sentence_cue_checks.text: Use a desktop installer for a ready-to-launch application, pip for a Python virtual environment, or conda-forge for a Conda environment.
cues: Use a desktop installer for a ready-to-launch application, pip for a Python virtual environment, or conda-forge for a Conda environment.

sentence_cue_checks.text: Start from the official spaCR links shown here.
cues: Start from the official spaCR links shown here.

sentence_cue_checks.text: On PyPI, find spaCR and read the installation command beside the current release.
cues: On PyPI, find spaCR and read the installation command beside the current release.

sentence_cue_checks.text: Copy that command when you are ready to install into your Python environment.
cues: Copy that command when you are ready to install into your Python environment.

sentence_cue_checks.text: The pip tutorial shows how to create and activate that environment first.
cues: The pip tutorial shows how to create and activate that environment first.

sentence_cue_checks.text: Use Project links to open the documentation, source repository or issue tracker.
cues: Use Project links to open the documentation, source repository or issue tracker.

sentence_cue_checks.text: Bookmark the documentation so you can return to the module walkthroughs while working in spaCR.
cues: Bookmark the documentation so you can return to the module walkthroughs while working in spaCR.

sentence_cue_checks.text: On GitHub, open the spaCR repository.
cues: On GitHub, open the spaCR repository.

sentence_cue_checks.text: Main contains the release source, and nightly contains the latest development work.
cues: Main contains the release source, and nightly contains the latest development work.

sentence_cue_checks.text: For a packaged desktop installation, open Releases and choose a release.
cues: For a packaged desktop installation, open Releases and choose a release.

sentence_cue_checks.text: Expand Assets and download the installer for Windows, macOS or Linux.
cues: Expand Assets and download the installer for Windows, macOS or Linux.

sentence_cue_checks.text: Keep the checksum file from the same release if you want to verify the download.
cues: Keep the checksum file from the same release if you want to verify the download.

sentence_cue_checks.text: The Platform installers lesson walks through launching the installer and opening spaCR.
cues: The Platform installers lesson walks through launching the installer and opening spaCR.

sentence_cue_checks.text: On conda-forge, open the spaCR package page and check the available version.
cues: On conda-forge, open the spaCR package page and check the available version.

sentence_cue_checks.text: Package channels can update at different times, so select the version available through the route you choose.
cues: Package channels can update at different times, so select the version available through the route you choose.

sentence_cue_checks.text: The conda-forge command installs spaCR into your active Conda environment.
cues: The conda-forge command installs spaCR into your active Conda environment.

sentence_cue_checks.text: Follow the Conda lesson to create that environment, install the package and launch the application.
cues: Follow the Conda lesson to create that environment, install the package and launch the application.

sentence_cue_checks.text: Continue with pip, Conda or Platform installers.
cues: Continue with pip, Conda or Platform installers.

sentence_cue_checks.text: Once spaCR opens, move to the Home lesson, then the pipeline overviews to choose a workflow for your data.
cues: Once spaCR opens, move to the Home lesson, then the pipeline overviews to choose a workflow for your data.
